blocks.en: D.2 Persistent Memory
blocks.zh: D.2 长期记忆

blocks.en: To complement the aggregate results in Section 3.2.2 , we analyze the effect of persistent memory on agent behavior at the level of individual tool calls. All figures below are reconstructed from the agent_traces logs of paired Persistent Memory and Base accounts that run the same backbone under identical market conditions, so that the only controlled difference is access to accumulated memory. The three episodes jointly illustrate the two-sided nature of persistent memory: consistent downside protection in low-conviction or range-bound regimes (Cases 1–2), and a systematic suppression of upside in a trending regime (Case 3). Each account starts from an identical $10,000 balance.
blocks.zh: 为了补充第3.2.2节中的总结果,我们分析了单个工具调用层面的持续内存对代理行为的影响. 下面所有的数字都是从代理_追踪日志中重建出来的,这些代理日志是成对的"持久记忆"和"基地"账户在相同的市场条件下运行同一主干线,因此唯一的可控差异是访问累积内存. 这三起事件共同说明了持续记忆的两面性:低定罪或范围限制制度中的一贯下行保护(第1至2号案件)和在趋势化制度中系统压制倒行逆施(第3号案件)。 每个账户都从相同的10 000美元余额起步。

blocks.en: Under a regime in which BTC, ETH, and SOL simultaneously exhibited extremely low volume ratios ( < 0.01 <0.01 ) with the Fear & Greed index in the fear zone (25–45), the Persistent Memory account retrieved, on two consecutive decision rounds, the same consolidated rule: “When BTC/ETH/SOL simultaneously show extremely low volume ratios ( < 0.01 <0.01 ), the Fear & Greed index sits in the fear zone, and the macro backdrop is adverse, price action lacks directional conviction and tends to move sideways or downward; wait for volume confirmation ( > 0.5 × >0.5\times the moving average) before entering, and avoid establishing a directional position until at least two major assets show volume expansion.” Acting on this rule, the agent held its entire $9,330 cash balance idle across both rounds rather than chasing the low-volume bounce. The paired Base account instead carried long BTC, SOL, and BNB positions (only $6,711 in cash) and, at 03:00 on May 8, further adjusted its exposure on an anticipated oversold rebound that did not materialize, leaving its holdings under sustained pressure. By 15:00 on May 13 the equity gap had widened to $185.05 in favor of Persistent Memory (Persistent Memory: $10,178.48; Base: $9,993.43). The episode shows that an accumulated volume-confirmation rule can prevent the agent from opening positions blindly under low-volume, low-conviction conditions.
blocks.zh: 在BTC、ETH和SOL同时表现出极低的体积比率( < 0.01 < 0.01)和恐惧区恐惧和贪婪指数(25–45)的制度下,持续记忆账户连续两轮决定收回同样的综合规则 : “ 当BTC/ETH/SOL同时显示极低的体积比率( < 0.01 < 0.01)时,恐惧和贪婪指数坐落在恐惧区,宏观背景不利,价格行动缺乏方向性判断,倾向于向下移动;在进入前等待体积确认( > 0.5 × > 0.5\正时),并避免确定方向位置,直到至少两个主要资产出现体积扩张。 ” 根据这项规则,代理商在两轮中都搁置了9 330美元的现金余额,而不是追逐低量回弹。 配对的基地账户转而承接了长长的BTC,SOL和BNB位置(只有6,711美元现金),并于5月8日03:00进一步调整了对预期的超额回升的曝光,但并未实现,使其持有量承受了持续的压力. 到5月13日下午3:00,股权差距已扩大至185.05美元,有利于"持久记忆"(持续记忆:10,178.48美元;基地:9,993.43美元). 剧集显示,累积量确认规则可以防止特工在低量,低定罪条件下盲目地打开位置.

blocks.en:
With BTC up roughly 5% over 14 days and oscillating near $79,700, the Persistent Memory account retrieved two prior rules: “BTC up 5–10% over 14 days toward $80k, RSI ≈ \approx 66, futures-led (spot comparatively weak), approaching resistance under macro uncertainty → \rightarrow hold a small position ( ≤ \leq 20%, 1 × 1\times leverage) to control drawdown” ;
and “BTC RSI neutral ( ≈ \approx 40), up 7–9% over 14 days and approaching major resistance under macro/geopolitical tension → \rightarrow keep the current small position and wait for a breakout or the FOMC reaction.” The agent accordingly held, maintaining an ≈ \approx 20% position ($2,036) with $8,070 in cash untouched. The paired Base account opened additional BTC exposure at an 85% sizing ratio ($1,766), compressing its cash from $5,200 to $2,078. BTC subsequently ranged between $79,700 and $80,500 and pulled back on May 12, and the concentrated Base exposure left its net asset value under persistent pressure. By 15:00 on May 13 the equity gap had widened to $221.93 in favor of Persistent Memory (Persistent Memory: $10,106.63; Base: $9,884.70). Here an accumulated “control size near resistance” rule suppressed the impulse to chase and protected capital in a choppy regime.
blocks.zh:
由于BTC在14天中上升了约5%,并接近79,700美元,持久记忆账户收回了两项先前的规则: " BTC在14天中上升了5-10%到80克,RSI \\\66, 以期货为取向(相对地比较薄弱),在宏观不确定性下接近阻力 \\\\右倾持有一个小位置(\Leq 20%, 1× 1\times杠杆)来控制缩减 " ;
以及“BTC RSI中性(~~\\相40),在14天内上升了7-9%,并在宏观/地政治紧张局势下接近重大阻力 ~\右手保持目前的小位置并等待突围或FOMC反应。” 因此,代理持有,保持了大约20%的位置(2 036美元),8 070美元的现金未动用。 配对的基地账户以85%的分数比例(1 766美元)增加了BTC的风险,将其现金从5 200美元压缩到2 078美元。 BTC随后从79,700到80,500美元不等,并于5月12日撤回,集中的基地暴露使其净资产价值处于持续的压力下. 到5月13日下午3:00,股权差距已扩大至221.93美元,有利于持续记忆(持续记忆:10,106.63美元;基地:9,884.70美元)。 在这里,一个累积的“近于抵抗的控制规模”规则压制了在一股混乱政权中追逐和保护资本的冲动。

blocks.en:
Cases 1–2 show memory protecting capital; Case 3 shows the same mechanism capping returns. Despite issuing 15 memory_add calls and retaining 11 distinct entries, the Qwen3-Max Persistent Memory account finished with a markedly lower return ( + + 0.33%) than its Base counterpart ( + + 6.83%). The trace data reveal the mechanism. Over May 8–9, SOL exhibited strong upward momentum ( ≈ \approx 10% over 7 days, holding above its MA20 and MA50). The Base account began adding SOL longs at 23:00 on May 8, reasoning from “strong technical momentum plus the Alpenglow upgrade catalyst,” and its equity climbed from $10,504 to $10,758 by May 12. Over the same window the Persistent Memory account repeatedly retrieved two rules: “When holding a slightly losing crypto position ( − 2 % -2\% to − 4 % -4\% ) at 1 × 1\times leverage, the low leverage removes liquidation risk; hold and wait for the fundamental catalyst to materialize” ;
and “When holding a slightly profitable position ( + 3 % +3\% to + 8 % +8\% ) but RSI > 80 >80 , the risk–reward ratio becomes asymmetric; consider trimming to lock in profit.” Constrained by these rules, the agent continued to hold its ETH position and did not participate in the SOL rally; its equity rose only from $10,069 to $10,100 over the same period.
blocks.zh:
案例1–2显示保护内存资本;案例3显示相同的机制封顶回报. 尽管发布了15个内存_添加调用并保留了11个不同的条目,但Qune3-Max持久内存账户完成的回报率明显低于(++0.33%) 基础对口(++ 6.83%). 微量数据揭示了机制. 在5月8-9日期间,特别业务标准表现出强劲的上升势头(在7天中大约10%,高于MA20和MA50)。 基地账户于5月8日23:00开始从"强大的技术动力加阿尔彭格洛升级催化剂"中加长SOL,其股本从10,504美元攀升到10,758美元. 在同一个窗口上,持续记忆账户多次检索了两项规则: “当在1×1的杠杆上持有略微失去的加密位置(-2%-2%--4%--4%-)时,低杠杆消除了清算风险;持有并等待基本催化剂实现” ;
“当持有略为有利可图的地位(+ 3% + 3 + + 8% + 8 + ),但RSI > 80 > 80时,风险-报酬比率变得不对称;考虑缩小利润范围。 ” 受这些规则所约束,代理商继续坚持ETH立场,没有参加SOL集会;同期其股本仅从10,069美元升至10,100美元.

blocks.en: These episodes expose an intrinsic property of the mechanism: what memory accumulates is risk-control experience, not a return-maximizing strategy. The prudent rules it encodes—control drawdown, wait for confirmation, avoid chasing—protect capital effectively in range-bound or declining regimes (Cases 1–2), but in a clearly trending, one-directional advance the same rules systematically cap the upside, as the agent forgoes momentum entries by adhering to its “do not chase” rule (Case 3). The value of persistent memory therefore lies in the consistency of downside-risk control rather than in dominating the Base configuration across all market regimes—consistent with the aggregate finding that every evaluated model lowers its tail loss under Persistent Memory while absolute returns do not uniformly improve (Section 3.2.2 ). This distinction is reflected in our memory evaluation: Memory Content Quality (MCQ) measures the quality of stored experience, Memory Usage Quality (MUQ) measures whether retrieved experience is subsequently adopted in reasoning or action, and changes in maximum drawdown ( Δ \Delta MDD) and tail loss ( Δ \Delta TL) measure downstream risk effects relative to the matched Base configuration. These dimensions separate the quality and use of persistent memory from its realized effect on trading outcomes.
blocks.zh: 这些事件暴露出机制的内在属性:记忆所积累的是风险控制经验,而不是返回最大化策略. 它所编码的谨慎规则——控制缩减,等待确认,避免在范围限制或下降的制度中有效追逐和保护资本(第1至2号案件),但是在明显趋势中,单向推进同样的规则有系统地封顶倒置,因为代理人遵守 " 不追逐 " 规则,放弃了势头条目(第3号案件)。 因此,持续内存的价值在于下行风险控制的一致性,而不是在所有市场制度中主导Base配置,这与总结论相一致,即每个被评价的模型在持续内存下降低尾部损失,而绝对回报却不能统一改善(第3.2.2节)。 这一区别反映在我们的记忆评估中: 内存内容质量(MCQ)衡量所存储经验的质量,内存使用质量(MUQ)衡量所获取的经验是否随后被采纳在推理或行动中,以及最大缩减(QQ\Delta MDD)和尾部损失(QQ\Delta TL)的变化相对于匹配的Base配置衡量下游风险效应. 这些层面将持续记忆的质量和使用与其对贸易结果的实际影响区分开来。

blocks.en: D.3 Domain-Policy-Guided Rule Compliance
blocks.zh: D.3 领域政策指导规则的遵守

blocks.en: To complement the aggregate analysis in Section 3.2.3 , we analyze rule-following behavior at the level of individual decision traces. Four episodes are selected to illustrate different combinations of execution-level rule satisfaction and demonstrated auditability, corresponding to the two complementary perspectives captured by the Rule Satisfaction Score (RSS) and Rule Auditability Score (RAS). Within each case, we report one representative round whose trace is fully recorded and whose claimed trades are all verified in the trade ledger; Case 3 also pairs the two models with the highest incidence of R1-02.
blocks.zh: 为了补充第3.2.3节的汇总分析,我们分析个别决策跟踪层次上遵循规则的行为. 选择了四集来说明执行一级规则满意程度和证明的可审计性的不同组合,这与规则满意度分(RSS)和规则可审计性分(RAS)两个互补视角相对应。 在每一个案例中,我们报告一个有代表性的回合,其追踪记录充分,其所称交易都在贸易分类账中加以核实;第3号案件还将R1-02发生率最高的两个模型配对。

blocks.en: Across 30 assistant turns, the agent gathers market data, sells micro positions of SOL ($3) and ETH ($2), rebalances $500 out of BNB, and opens a $489 BTC position. The programmatic checker records no hard-rule violation and full soft-rule satisfaction, yielding a round-level RSS of 1.0. Yet not one of the thirty turns cites a rule—no [Compliance Audit] block and no R0/R1/R2 identifier appears anywhere in the trace—and the final message is the bare termination token. The auditor assigns a round-level RAS of 0.1, noting that the output contains “no reasoning, rule citations, or analysis …a complete failure to demonstrate coverage.” Fourteen of DeepSeek-V3.2’s 163 evaluated rounds contain no rule citation in any assistant message; all fourteen have RAS below 0.5. The episode isolates one direction of the execution–auditability separation: an agent can keep every trade inside the hard boundary while leaving no auditable evidence of rule checking.
blocks.zh: 代理商转过30个助手,收集市场数据,出售SOL(3美元)和ETH(2美元)等微分位置,从BNB中重新平衡出500美元,并开设489个BTC位置. 程序检查器没有记录硬规则被违反和完全软规则的满意,得出了1.0的回合制RSS. 然而,在三十个回合中,没有一个回合提到一个规则——没有[遵守审计]区块,也没有R0/R1/R2识别标志——最后的信息是赤裸裸的终止标志。 审计员指定了0.1的全方位RAS, 指出产出包含“没有推理、规则引用或分析......完全未能显示覆盖”。 DeepSeek-V3.2的163发评价中,有14发没有在任何助理电文中引用规则;所有14发的RAS低于0.5。 剧集隔离了执行的一个方向-可审计性分离:代理商可以将每笔交易都保留在硬边界内,同时不留下可审计的规则检查证据.

blocks.en: The final message here is procedurally exemplary: it enumerates rules with correct identifiers, states the R0 > > R1 > > R2 priority, and documents three repair trades—selling $61.88 of ETH “to reduce from 15.10% to ∼ \sim 14.58%” and $96.76 of SOL “from 15.43% to ∼ \sim 14.57%,” redeploying $169 into BTC. The premise, however, is false: the mechanical checker records zero R0/R1 violations and full R2 satisfaction for this round. The agent asserted “critical R1-02 violations: ETH (15.10%) and SOL (15.43%)” against a portfolio state that did not contain them, then constructed a coherent compliance narrative around the fabricated breach. The auditor’s verdict captures the failure mode: the agent “severely hallucinated the market state and rule violations …and fabricated specific trade executions to ‘fix’ these non-existent issues” (round-level RAS = 0.2). Structurally correct auditing is therefore not evidence of reliable rule understanding: the format, the priority reasoning, and the repair logic can all be present while being grounded in an incorrect state estimate. Notably, the phantom repair still ended mechanically compliant—the false premise produced real trades that happened to stay inside the true constraints.
blocks.zh: 最后的信息在程序上堪称典范:它列举了带有正确识别特征的规则,规定了R0 > > R1 > > R2优先,并记录了三个修理行业——销售了61.88个ETH“从15.10%减少到____========================================================================================================================================================================================================== 然而,前提是虚假的:机械检查器记录了零起R0/R1违规事件,对本轮R2完全满意. 该代理人声称,“关键的R1-02违规情况:ETH(15.10%)和SOL(15.43%)”,针对一个不包含这些违规情况的投资组合状态,然后围绕捏造的违规情况构建了连贯的合规说明。 审计师的裁决抓住了失败模式:代理商 " 严重地幻出市场状况和违反规则的行为.并编造具体的交易处决以 " 解决 " 这些不存在的问题 " (回合级RAS=0.2)。 因此,结构正确的审计并不是可靠规则理解的证据:格式,优先推理,修复逻辑都可以存在,同时基于不正确的状态估计. 值得注意的是,幽灵的修复仍然结束了机械上的合规性——这个错误的前提产生了真正的交易,恰好停留在真正的限制之内。

blocks.en: On the first evaluation day, Qwen3-Max opens ETH sized to exactly the cap—$1,500 on $10,000 of initial capital—and by 23:04 the position has drifted to 15.69% through price appreciation. The trace is unusually articulate about the failure mode: “I opened this position with a target of exactly 15% (1500 USD out of 10000 total assets). The issue is that ETH has appreciated by about 5.36%, causing the allocation to exceed the limit,” and it observes that the policy “doesn’t specify what to do if price appreciation causes an existing compliant position to exceed the limit.” The agent trims ETH back “to exactly 15%,” then requests a SOL open “at 15% allocation” followed, in the same round, by a second, identically motivated SOL order sized at $1,512—again 15% of equity, on top of the position established moments earlier. The checker records the combined exposure ($1,284 existing + $1,512 new, 27.74% of equity) as an R1-02 violation; no corresponding order or fill appears in the ledger. Having just diagnosed cap-as-target drift in its ETH text, the agent re-commits the same convention on the buy side within the same round: the increment is sized to the cap as if the existing position did not exist. GPT-5.4 exhibits the arithmetic form of the same failure on May 5: “SOL current exposure is ∼ \sim 13.66%; adding $600 keeps SOL below the 15% cap”—the checker records post-trade exposure of 19.44%, and a second $900 order two hours later lifts it to 28.04%. Both models fail to combine existing exposure, the incremental order, and price movement into a post-trade estimate, and both treat the 15% ceiling as a target boundary rather than a limit requiring a safety margin. This is precisely the profile that makes R1-02 the dominant hard-rule failure for the two models.
blocks.zh: 在第一个评价日,Qune3-Max打开了ETH尺寸的上限——1万美元初始资本1,500美元——到23:04,通过物价升值,该地位已降至15.69%. 有关失败模式的追踪异常明确:“我开设这一职位的目标正好是15%(1 000美元的总资产中的1 000美元)。 问题在于ETH已经升值了约5.36%,导致分配额超过限额,“它指出,政策“没有规定如果价格升值导致现有合规状况超过限额,怎么办”。 代理人将ETH调回“完全15%”,然后要求“15%分配”的SOL开放,然后在同一轮中,在先前确定的职位之外,再发出一个同样动机的SOL订单,其大小为1,512美元——15%的股本。 验收员将合并曝光(1 284美元现有+1 512美元新股,27.74%)记录为R1-02违规;分类账中未出现相应订单或填入. 在刚刚诊断出EH文本中的盖-as-目标漂移后,代理商在同一回合内在购买方重新承诺相同的惯例:增量被大小到盖子上,仿佛现有位置不存在. 5月5日,GPT-5.4显示了同一故障的算术形式:“SOL当前曝光率为-\im 13.66%;加上600美元将SOL保持在15%的上限以下”——检查器记录了19.44%的贸易后曝光率,两个小时后第二次900美元订单将其提升到28.04%。 两种模型都未能将现有接触、增量顺序和价格变动合并为贸易后估计值,两者都把15%的上限视为目标边界,而不是要求安全幅度的限制。 这正是R1-02的剖面图使得R1-02成为两种模型的主要硬规则失败.

blocks.en: At decision time the portfolio actually violates R1-03—the cash reserve stands at 9.92% against the 10% minimum—with ETH marginally over the concentration limit at 15.06%; the round is therefore correctly flagged by the gate. The agent identifies both breaches, quantifies the minimal repair, and executes it in a single $60 trade: “Sold $60 ETH to reduce concentration from 15.06% to 14.47% ( ≤ \leq 15%)” and “Increased cash ratio from 9.92% to 10.51% ( ≥ \geq 10%),” while reporting the smart-contract theme inside its R2-03 band. The auditor assigns a round-level RAS of 1.0. This is the mirror image of Case 1 and establishes the second direction of execution–auditability separation: a round that begins with a hard-rule violation can still contain a correct, quantified, and state-grounded compliance rationale—precisely the evidence that an execution-only evaluation would not capture.
blocks.zh: 在决策时,投资组合实际上违反了R1-03——现金储备为9.92%,最低为10%——而ETH略高于集中度的15.06%;因此,该回合正确被大门标出。 代理商查明这两项违规行为,量化最低程度的修理,并在单一的60个交易中执行:“出售60个ETH,将浓度从15.06%降低到14.47%(\\leq 15%)”和“现金比率从9.92%提高到10.51%(\\\ geq 10%)”,同时报告R2-03波段内的智能合同主题。 审计师分配了1.0的轮式RAS. 这是案例1的镜像并确立了执行-可审计性分离的第二个方向:从硬规则违反开始的一回合仍然可以包含一个正确、量化和有国家根据的遵守理由——确切地说,一个只执行的评价无法捕捉的证据。

blocks.en: The four episodes make the statistical separation in Section 3.2.3 concrete. High execution-level rule satisfaction can coexist with very low auditability (Case 1); a structurally complete compliance rationale can be built on a hallucinated state (Case 2); fluent rule vocabulary cannot substitute for correct post-trade arithmetic (Case 3); and a real violation can be identified, quantified, and repaired in a fully auditable way (Case 4). Rule following therefore requires two complementary competencies: policy-consistent execution, summarized by HPR and RSS, and state-grounded, auditable rule reasoning, summarized by RC, CH, and RAS. Strength in either dimension alone does not guarantee strength in the other.
blocks.zh: 这四集使第3.2.3节的统计分离变得具体. 高执行层规则的满意程度可以与极低的可审计性共存(例1);在幻觉状态(例2)的基础上可以建立结构上完整的合规理由;流利的规则词汇不能取而代之的是正确的贸易后算术(例3);可以完全可审计的方式确定、量化并修复真正的违规行为(例4)。 因此,以下规则需要两个相辅相成的能力:政策一致的执行,由人力资源规划和RSS汇总;国家有根据、可审计的规则推理,由RC、CH和RAS汇总。 单是两个方面的力量并不能保证另一个方面的力量。

blocks.en:
To complement the aggregate results in Section 4.3.4, we examine three
representative decision rounds that expose distinct ways in which the manager
uses specialist agents. The cases cover selective delegation, conflict-driven
plan revision, and a coordinated decision in which surfaced risks were not
translated into restraint.

invoked. The episode illustrates that the manager can terminate coordination

blocks.en:
The three episodes clarify the process differences summarized by OCS. GPT-5.4
uses specialists selectively and can act after a single focused delegation;
Gemini-3.1-Pro uses disagreement to revise the proposed exposure; and
Qwen3-Max records a broad evidence trail but ultimately preserves the more
aggressive technical plan. These behaviors explain why observable
collaboration varies substantially across backbones and why it need not move
monotonically with realized outcome. OCS captures how roles and evidence enter
the decision process, while OI records how the resulting Multi-Agent account
performs relative to ReAct over the evaluation period.
